provenance.host_isolation: Shared development host; no exclusive CPU reservation. Repeated process cohorts and rotated lane order, not a controlled laboratory.

capability_gap: Ink does not currently expose a general arbitrary JSON snapshot diff or the Frontier patch opcode vocabulary. Diff-discovery controls are Frontier-only; compiled Ink receives known source edits.
scope: Shared safe-integer/Unicode JSON domain; JSON member order and exact number token spelling are additional Ink observations not measured here; binary formats carry distinct schema/protocol overhead. Agreed-schema transport requires exact format/schema negotiation outside the message; portable wire and checkpoints remain separate.
